format.summary: Summary: {ok} OK, {warn} to keep an eye on, {fail} error(s).
system.not_debian: {name}: only Debian (and Raspberry Pi OS) is tested
fix.python: Python 3.11 or newer is required (Debian 12 and later)
module.role.serial: HF spectrum through the rig's second port (pyserial)
fix.reinstall: Run the installation again: sudo bash install.sh
software.hamlib_unreadable: Hamlib version unreadable: the spectrum needs Hamlib 4.6 or newer
software.hamlib_too_old: Hamlib {version} too old: 4.6 or newer required (rigctld would refuse to start)
fix.hamlib_update: Update Hamlib, or set [spectrum] enabled = false
fix.relogin_or_reinstall: Log out and back in (trx group), or run the installation again
config.service_cannot_read: the service (trx account) cannot read it
hardware.group_relogin: granted to {user}, active from the next session
fix.group_relogin: Log out and back in (step 4 of the guide)
hardware.group_absent: {user} is not a member: {role} not possible
fix.group_add: sudo usermod -aG {group} {user}, then log out and back in
fix.serial_ports: Switch the rig on and check the USB cable (not a charge-only cable)
fix.model_unknown: Pick a close model in the wizard, or install a newer Hamlib
hardware.cat_absent: {port} missing: rig switched off or unplugged
fix.cat_absent: Switch the rig on, check the cable, then run the diagnostic again
hardware.modemmanager: active: it may “probe” the rig's port and disturb CAT
fix.modemmanager: Run the installation again: it makes it ignore the serial ports
hardware.brltty: may grab some USB serial adapters (CP210x, CH340)
fix.brltty: Run the installation again and answer no to the braille display question
fix.sound_cards: Plug in the rig's USB cable (it often carries the sound card)
fix.card_missing: Rig switched off or unplugged? Otherwise choose it again in the wizard
audio.busy: {name}: plugged in ({card}) but held by another program, probably the desktop sound (PipeWire)
audio.desktop_default_out: the rig's card is the desktop's default sound output
audio.desktop_default_in: the rig's card is the desktop's default sound input
audio.desktop_default_both: the rig's card is the desktop's default sound output and input
audio.pipewire_active: active: it may hold the rig's sound card while a session is open
fix.pipewire: If the station has no sound, see “Troubleshooting” in the guide
fix.safe_mode: Fix the cause, then the “Leave safe mode” menu
spectrum.no_pyserial: pyserial module missing: the spectrum cannot work (normal mode)
fix.pyserial: Run the installation again (sudo bash install.sh), or: pip install pyserial
spectrum.unknown: status unknown: gateway stopped (checked when it starts)
fix.spectrum: Fix the rig setting, then check: trx-setup --spectre {port} (station stopped); or trx-setup --spectre off
spectrum.waiting: waiting for confirmed receive before opening the port
cluster.secrets_absent: missing although {names} is expected in it: connecting without a password
fix.cluster_password: Enter the password again: openRemoteTRX Console, menu 5.1
cluster.secrets_rights: permissions {mode}: passwords readable by other accounts
cluster.secrets_ok_unix: present, readable by the station account only
cluster.no_state: no published status: module not started yet, or station stopped
fix.cluster_run: Check [modules] run and start the station (menu 1.1)
cluster.state_old: status {age} s old: module stopped or stuck
fix.cluster_journal: Log (menu 6.2); the supervisor restarts it if it stopped
fix.cluster_test: Test the source: openRemoteTRX Console, menu 5.1
cluster.no_spot: no spot received since the module started
cluster.last_spot: {age} s ago; {per_minute} spot(s)/min, {cache} in memory, {malformed} unreadable line(s)
cluster.cty: {problem}: countries unknown, continent filter not working
fix.network: Check the network connection (cable or Wi-Fi)
network.local_only: disabled: station reachable from this PC only
network.port_closed: {port} closed: gateway stopped or API refused
update.no_key: no known key: automatic update impossible
fix.install_published: Install a published release (sudo bash install.sh)
update.not_yet: not done yet (2 minutes after start-up)
fix.internet: Check the Internet connection; automatic retry in 24 h
